Tromyzon Entroplasma.location: Dismantled from Tromyzon servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Tromyzon in Orb Vallis Pond Hotspots during Cold weather. Also drops from the Exploiter Orb in the Orb Vallis.

Tubercular Gill System.location: Cut from the following Cambion Drift fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos): Ostimyr, Aquapulmo, Vitreospina, Myxostomata and Duroid.

Vainthorn.location: Abyssal Zone on Ceres (requires Abyssal Beacons to access)

Vega Toroid.location: Earn Vega Toroids from enemies located at the Spaceport in the Orb Vallis and from Mite Raknoids. They can also be found as pick-ups in caves located around the Orb Vallis (Venus).

Venerol.location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Red Mining Veins and Resource Containers

Veridos.location: Plains of Eidolon (Earth) from Blue Mining Veins and Thumpers

Vessel Capillaries.location: Obtained from Disruption missions on Armatus, Deimos.

Vestan Moss.location: Obtained by gathering Vestan Moss plants that grow on Mercury, Saturn, and Sedna

Vestigial Motes.location: Obtained from Ascension missions on Brutus, Uranus.

Volatile Motes.location: Obtained from Operation Ascension missions (Brutus on Uranus) and special Operation Alerts during Operation: Belly of the Beast.

Waxen Sebum Deposit.location: Cut from Amniophysi fish via Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos). Catch Amniophysi in Cambion Drift caves during Vome and Fass.

Xenorhast.location: Cambion Drift (Deimos) from Blue Mining Lesions. This Rare Gem can only be mined by the Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill.

Yogwun Stomach.location: Cut from Yogwun fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Yogwun in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

Zodian.location: Orb Vallis (Venus) from Blue Mining Veins and the Exploiter Orb. This Rare Gem can only be mined by the Advanced Nosam Cutter or Sunpoint Plasma Drill.

Lanzo Fishing Spear.location: Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish: Charc Eel, Cuthol, Goopolla, Murkray, Sharrac and Yogwun.

Tulok Fishing Spear.location: Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish: Tralok.

Peram Fishing Spear.location: Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish: Glappid, Khut-Khut, Mawfish, Mortus Lungfish and Norg.

Shockprod Fishing Spear.location: Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

Stunna Fishing Spear.location: Obtained from The Business in Fortuna. This spear is most effective on Servofish found in the Orb Vallis (Venus).

Ebisu Spear.location: Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).

Spari Spear.location: Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk. This spear is most effective on fish found in the Cambion Drift (Deimos).

Live Heartcell.location: Earned upon Vanquishing a Technocyte Coda in Höllvania.

Scuttler Husk.location: Obtained by defeating Oraxia in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

Temporal Dust.location: Obtained from Murmur in Isleweaver missions (Duviri)

Dominus Aureus.location: Obtained by completing Isleweaver missions in Duviri during Operation: Eight Claw

Ignia.location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).

Maphica.location: Obtained from crates and bosses in the Descendia (Dark Refractory).

Ren Hypercore.location: Obtained from Recall: Dactolyst missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).

Lyroic Bridge.location: Obtained from Recall: Hunhullus missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory)

Ascaris Prime.location: Obtained from Recall: Vanguard missions in The Perita Rebellion (The Dark Refractory).

Agnovidisc.location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions (Dark Refractory).

Servoris.location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions(Dark Refractory).

Laudavi.location: Obtained from crates and enemies in Perita Rebellion missions(Dark Refractory).

Crimson Talent.location: Support Vena against Ryoku (Scoria's Angel, Uranus Proxima)

Emerald Talent.location: Support Ryoku against Vena (The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima)
